def find_components(grid, target):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])

                while q:

                    if (rr,cc) in visited: continue
                    visited.add((rr,cc))
                    comp.append((rr,cc))
                    for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
